reviews.author: Miranda Abbott
reviews.text: This gentleman was truly a blessing to find on a day i was losing hope! I will be using them for any tow needs in the future. He was very polite and professional. I told him what i needed done and he said no problem. He charged half of what the other guys charged and did it by himself. I called 3 tow companies before him. The first one I called gave me a price then once they got to the job site tried to change the price because I had a few items in the vehicle. The second one I called wanted to charge me almost 300$ to move it 2.1 miles away in the same city. The third i called said it would be at least 200$ but probably more when he came out. I asked why he couldn't give me a set price and the guy responded by being rude or talking how to where i couldnt hear him with no real reason of the price change. After Mr Adkins towed my vehicle to its destination when he was about to unload i asked him if it would be possible to tow it somewhere else and he didnt hesitate to get the job done. The new destination was almost 40 miles away and altogether cost me less then all 3 of the first tow companies I called. Thank you so much for all your help and kindness. It really meant alot in the moment I was having.

reviews.author: Dani Seavert
reviews.text: If I could give 100 stars I would! Called and answered quickly, told us he could be there in 15 min. Very friendly, hardworking, customer service oriented! Got our car opened quickly and was incredibly reasonable. Mr. Adkins saved us! Thank you!!
